contentHtml:
Introduction: The Advent of AI Workmates

The digital transformation journey is not a solo endeavor. At Positive, headquartered in Novi Sad, we're pioneering the future of work by creating AI Assistants, a new breed of digital colleagues revolutionizing how tasks are executed and managed.

The Foundation: OpenAI's Assistants API

Leveraging OpenAI's Assistants API, our AI Assistants perform a vast array of tasks. With this technology still in its beta phase, we're at the cutting edge, actively contributing to its evolution and enhancing its functionality.

Customized Digital Companions

Each AI Assistant is not just a tool but a customizable entity, capable of adapting its personality and capabilities to suit specific job tasks. This bespoke approach ensures a seamless integration into any job description, offering a enjoyable experience.

Synergy in Versatility

Imagine an assistant that not only understands code but also manages data retrieval, all while keeping the nuances of natural conversation. OpenAI-hosted tools and those we develop, our AI Assistants are capable, and great in parallel tool access.

The Power of Persistence: Threads and Files
Our AI Assistants utilize Threads for conversation management, caring not to lose any detail in the breadth of business communications. They are adept at handling Files, whether it's creating visual content or solving numbers in spreadsheets, enhancing documentation and decision-making.

A Single Interface, Multiple Experts

What sets Positive’s AI Assistants apart is the convergence of expert systems into one interface. They work in financial analysis, creative design, or technical troubleshooting. Each assistant brings a unique set of skills, creating a virtual team at your fingertips.

The Impact on Job Descriptions


The traditional job description is being redefined. With new AI Assistants, one can summon a marketing analyst, a design consultant, or a coding expert - all within the same digital environment. This fusion of capabilities is reshaping career trajectories and business operations.

Conclusion: The Dawn of AI-Enhanced Workplaces

Positive is not just creating new AI Assistants; we are crafting a future for each task. Synergy and innovation lead to unprecedented efficiency. As we continue to develop these assistants, we invite businesses and developers to join us in this journey. We want to share feedback and witness the change of the workplace into an AI-enhanced landscape.

Be Part of the Transformation

We're at the front of this exciting new era. Join us in reimagining the potential of every job task. Let's build a world where digital transformation is not just a goal but a reality, with Positive’s AI Assistants leading the charge.

If you want to know more about AI and LLM check out our other blogs.
